sandboxGroups.title: Foundations
sandboxGroups.summary: Typography, spacing, surfaces, and icon rhythm for the shared component language.

sandboxGroups.title: Inputs
sandboxGroups.summary: Field-level components for fast data entry, review, and configuration flows.

sandboxGroups.title: Actions
sandboxGroups.summary: Primary and secondary action treatments for inline and sectional flows.

sandboxGroups.title: Navigation
sandboxGroups.summary: Shared navigation primitives for segmenting dense workflows into focused views so pages do not turn into long vertical scrolls.

sandboxGroups.title: Feedback
sandboxGroups.summary: Status, alerts, loading, and empty-state surfaces that explain system state clearly.

sandboxGroups.title: Layout
sandboxGroups.summary: Page-level composition patterns for headers, scaffolds, sections, and split regions.

sandboxGroups.title: Data Display
sandboxGroups.summary: Reusable display surfaces for cards, lists, summaries, and metadata-heavy views.

sandboxGroups.title: Charts
sandboxGroups.summary: Apex-backed chart wrappers for operational trends, shares, fills, labels, and color tuning.

sandboxGroups.title: Mermaid
sandboxGroups.summary: First-party Mermaid.js wrapper for diagrams, syntax diagnostics, click events, and pan/zoom inspection.

sandboxGroups.title: Overlays
sandboxGroups.summary: Contextual and modal interaction layers for help, confirmation, and sticky actions.

sandboxGroups.title: Canvas
sandboxGroups.summary: Typed workbench and calendar surfaces plus runtime primitives and sandbox-only preview assets.

findings.title: Old AppComponents contains many basic primitives duplicated by BaseLib/Charts.
findings.evidence: Button, Card, TextBox, DropDown, Tabs, Chart, DataGrid, ProgressBar and related primitive enums exist in both repositories.

findings.title: No non-WebGL/non-Canvas test project is present for standard components.
findings.evidence: tests/ currently contains only CanDoItAll.Components.WebGlLib.Tests and CanDoItAll.Components.WebGlRunLib.Tests.

findings.title: Tailwind inputs include a mix of @apply and raw CSS layout/property declarations.
findings.evidence: Tailwind/input.css, controls/buttons.css, navigation/tabs.css, foundation/theme.css and forms/tag-editor.css contain substantial raw declarations and token work.

findings.title: Base component inheritance and attribute merging are not universal.
findings.evidence: StyledComponentBase centralizes Class, Style, AdditionalAttributes, but support models, compatibility shims, and some wrappers need a deliberate boundary.

findings.title: Sandbox is grouped, but coverage is sampled rather than one-to-one for every standard component.
findings.evidence: SandboxCatalogRegistry defines groups and examples, but many BaseLib components have zero direct example references.

findings.title: Canvas is still grouped inside the main sandbox registry.
findings.evidence: SandboxGroupKey includes Canvas and Examples include canvas preview entries, while this publishing bundle must exclude Canvas/WebGL work.

findings.title: Some old AppComponents behavior may be newer than BaseLib and must not be deleted blindly.
findings.evidence: Old AppComponents Button has an isClickInFlight guard; BaseLib Button adds anchors and compatibility looks but lacks that guard in current inspection.

findings.title: UI publishing proof must be visual and interactive, not source-only.
findings.evidence: Dropdowns, dialogs, tooltips, sticky action footers, tabs, and long-text/dense states require open-state screenshots and browser assertions.
